targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "Data Centers" FROM inventory.sites WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Racks" FROM inventory.racks r JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Servers" FROM inventory.servers sv LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id LEFT JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Virtual Machines" FROM inventory.virtual_machines vm JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) AS "Kubernetes Pods" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT count(DISTINCT a.id) AS "Applications" FROM inventory.applications a LEFT JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id LEFT JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring})

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center",s.latitude::double precision AS latitude,s.longitude::double precision AS longitude,count(DISTINCT r.id)::bigint AS "Rack Count",count(DISTINCT sv.id)::bigint AS "Server Count",CASE WHEN s.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.sites s LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.site_id=s.id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.room_id=rm.id LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.row_id=dr.id LEFT JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.rack_id=r.id WHERE s.latitude IS NOT NULL AND s.longitude IS NOT NULL AND (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) GROUP BY s.id,s.name,s.latitude,s.longitude,s.is_simulated ORDER BY s.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", r.name AS "Rack", sv.hostname AS "Server", sv.manufacturer AS "Vendor", sv.model AS "Model", sv.operating_system AS "OS", sc.physical_cores AS "CPU Cores", pg_size_pretty(sc.ram_bytes) AS "RAM", sc.gpu_count AS "GPUs", pg_size_pretty(sc.vram_bytes) AS "VRAM", pg_size_pretty(sc.local_storage_bytes) AS "Storage", sv.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN sv.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.servers sv JOIN inventory.server_capacity sc ON sc.id=sv.id LEFT JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id LEFT JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id LEFT JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id LEFT JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name, r.name, sv.hostname

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", vm.name AS "VM", vm.hostname AS "Hostname", h.hypervisor_type AS "Hypervisor", sv.hostname AS "Physical Host", vm.vcpu_count AS "vCPU", pg_size_pretty(vm.memory_bytes) AS "RAM", pg_size_pretty(vm.provisioned_storage_bytes) AS "Provisioned Storage", vm.operating_system AS "OS", vm.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN vm.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.virtual_machines vm JOIN inventory.hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id JOIN inventory.servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,vm.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", c.name AS "Cluster", n.name AS "Node", ns.name AS "Namespace", w.workload_type AS "Kind", w.name AS "Workload", p.name AS "Pod", p.phase AS "Phase", kc.name AS "Container", kc.image AS "Image", CASE WHEN p.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN inventory.k8s_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=c.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_nodes n ON n.id=p.node_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_workloads w ON w.id=p.workload_id LEFT JOIN inventory.k8s_containers kc ON kc.pod_id=p.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,c.name,ns.name,p.name,kc.name

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", nd.hostname AS "Device", nd.device_type AS "Type", nd.role AS "Role", nd.manufacturer AS "Vendor", nd.model AS "Model", nd.management_address::text AS "Management IP", r.name AS "Rack", nd.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN nd.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.network_devices nd JOIN inventory.racks r ON r.id=nd.rack_id JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,nd.hostname

SELECT s.name AS "Data Center", a.name AS "Application", a.environment AS "Environment", a.criticality AS "Criticality", ac.name AS "Component", ac.component_type AS "Type", ac.runtime AS "Runtime", ac.version AS "Version", a.status AS "Status", CASE WHEN a.is_simulated THEN 'Simulated' ELSE 'Live' END AS "Data Type" FROM inventory.applications a JOIN inventory.application_sites aps ON aps.application_id=a.id JOIN inventory.sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id LEFT JOIN inventory.application_components ac ON ac.application_id=a.id WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR s.site_key = ${site:sqlstring}) ORDER BY s.name,a.name,ac.name

WITH selected_sites AS (SELECT id FROM inventory.sites WHERE (${site:sqlstring} = 'All' OR site_key = ${site:sqlstring})), selected_racks AS (SELECT r.id FROM inventory.racks r JOIN inventory.data_center_rows dr ON dr.id=r.row_id JOIN inventory.rooms rm ON rm.id=dr.room_id JOIN selected_sites s ON s.id=rm.site_id), selected_servers AS (SELECT sv.id FROM inventory.servers sv JOIN selected_racks r ON r.id=sv.rack_id), selected_hypervisors AS (SELECT h.id FROM inventory.hypervisors h JOIN selected_servers sv ON sv.id=h.server_id), selected_clusters AS (SELECT c.id FROM inventory.k8s_clusters c JOIN selected_sites s ON s.id=c.site_id) SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'Data Centers'::text AS "Entity Type",(SELECT count(*) FROM selected_sites)::bigint AS "Count" UNION ALL SELECT 'Racks',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected_racks)::bigint UNION ALL SELECT 'Physical Servers',(SELECT count(*) FROM selected_servers)::bigint UNION ALL SELECT 'Virtual Machines',(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.virtual_machines vm JOIN selected_hypervisors h ON h.id=vm.hypervisor_id)::bigint UNION ALL SELECT 'Network Devices',(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.network_devices nd JOIN selected_racks r ON r.id=nd.rack_id)::bigint UNION ALL SELECT 'Kubernetes Pods',(SELECT count(*) FROM inventory.k8s_pods p JOIN inventory.k8s_namespaces ns ON ns.id=p.namespace_id JOIN selected_clusters c ON c.id=ns.cluster_id)::bigint UNION ALL SELECT 'Applications',(SELECT count(DISTINCT aps.application_id) FROM inventory.application_sites aps JOIN selected_sites s ON s.id=aps.site_id)::bigint) coverage ORDER BY "Entity Type"
